# Text-formatting summary

> **这页管什么**：哪种东西用哪种字体：粗体、斜体、代码字体、下划线，各自的唯一用途。
>
> 来源：<https://developers.google.com/style/text-formatting> · CC BY 4.0 · 本文件是**规则摘要**，非原文全文。

## Bold

UI elements and run-in headings. `<b>` or `**`. In Markdown prefer the double asterisk over double underscores.

## Italic

Use sparingly, for:

- Defining or introducing a term (first mention only).
- Emphasis — instead of bold or underline.
- Titles of full-length works (books, movies, web series).
- Mathematical variables.
- Version variables.

HTML: `<i>`, or `<em>` when the emphasis is real. Markdown: underscores, preferred over asterisks for clarity.

## Underline

**Link text only.** Nothing else.

## Code font

`<code>` or backticks for inline code, user input, filenames, class names, method names, HTTP status codes, console output, placeholders. Code blocks use `<pre>` or triple backticks.

Never override or modify font styles inline.

## Capitalization

American English norms. Sentence case for headings, titles, and navigation. Placeholders in all capitals.

## Quotation marks

American English style. Titles of shorter works (articles, episodes) get quotation marks unless part of a link.

## Font type, size, color

Never override global styles. Let semantic HTML or Markdown control appearance.

## Ampersands

Don't use `&` in place of *and*, except when naming a UI element or menu that itself uses `&`.
